posts.caption:
The group chat has been trying to plan padel since March. It's October.

So we built EffePadelle. You make a competition in three taps, share one link, and everyone's in. Same partner all season, or a new one every round.

The app sorts the rest. Who plays who, and an evening everyone is actually free.

Swipe to see how it works. We're live today in the App Store and on Google Play. Free to start.

A pain point they didn't know they had.

EffePadelle is an app for getting a padel game together, and the film had to feel like a Sunday: a house, an office, a birthday, and at the end a court.
